podcast.body: This song was recorded by Seattle's Bam Bam, featuring singer Tina Bell, in 1984. It is presented as an example of their distinctive grunge sound from an era before the genre became globally recognized. "Here is a song from Bam Bam called Ground Zero."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Unsung Heroes of Music: Part 2

podcast.body: This song was recorded in 1984 and is featured on BamBam's album "Free Fall from Space," representing their early grunge sound released years before the genre gained widespread recognition. "Here's just a song called Ground Zero. That's Seattle's BamBam featuring singer Tina Bell and it's from 1984."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
